name: Forest fire
description: Drossel-Schwabl forest fire, ForestFire 0.002/0.00001: empty ground grows a tree with probability p = 0.002 per generation, a tree is struck by lightning with probability f = 0.00001, and fire spreads to neighbouring trees and burns out in one step. Coloured by age, so the dark patches are recently burned ground and the brightest trees are new growth.
